title: Non-equivalent compactifications of Blaschke-product space
exact_target: Prove that changing the base Blaschke product gives different actual boundary compactifications in degree greater than two.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300014 (AMR-052-0014). CC BY 4.0.
Curt McMullen, Rational maps and Teichmüller space, in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (editors), Problems in holomorphic dynamics (1992). Example II, second boundary problem, p. 8.
